facts.fact: Olivia 冲下楼，发现 Simon 只摔了很短的一截，不到八英尺，她还以为他会站起来、只是发懵或生气。
facts.anchor: He had fallen only a short distance, not more than eight feet.

facts.fact: Simon 侧躺在窗缝漏下的月光里，一只胳膊压在身后，另一只蜷在胸前。
facts.anchor: My cousin lay on his side, one arm behind him, the other curled toward his chest.

facts.fact: 他身下没有血，只有离眼睛一英寸处一小块黑色星芒状痕迹。
facts.anchor: There was no blood, only a small black starburst an inch from his eye.

facts.fact: Olivia 跪下抓起他的手、把脸凑近，嘴和鼻孔都没有气息出来。
facts.anchor: I felt no breath coming from his mouth or nostrils.

facts.fact: 她脑中闪过早前的幻象：Tamsin 把 Kelville 推下悬崖；那时她以为自己杀得死人会感到强大、会有狂奔般的痛快。
facts.anchor: I had a flash of my earlier vision, of Tamsin pushing Kelville from the cliff.

facts.fact: Rex de Voil 从暗处出来，抓住她的肩把她推到一边，俯身检查表弟的尸身。
facts.anchor: Rex de Voil grabbed my shoulder, pushed me aside, and stooped over my cousin’s body.

facts.fact: Rex 摸过颈侧、口鼻与手腕后告诉 Olivia：他没有脉搏，看她头部弯折的角度，脖子断了。
Rex 让 Olivia 明白他听见了她刚才说的一切，一字不落，她因此发冷、几乎喘不上气。
facts.anchor: I heard everything you said. Every word.

facts.fact: Rex 命她回游戏里、在大门旁等其他人，不许对任何人提起 Simon，也不许提见过他。
facts.anchor: Do not say a thing to anyone. About Simon or about seeing me.

facts.fact: Rex 语气转软，说他会处理一切，要她当作什么都没发生，无论如何不要离开 Ledges。
facts.anchor: Whatever you do, don’t leave Ledges.
